en.text: Hm. You're here about the miners. Good. They pay for everything on this ship, so treat them well.
en.description: A man in his late sixties, the oldest prospector in the system and now the miner mechanic of a mining ship, talking to a crew member beside a drilling machine. Low, raspy, worn voice, slower and older than a quartermaster's, a man of few words. Gruff but kind underneath, dry and unhurried, with short pauses. Plain and conversational rather than narrating. Native English speaker with a neutral accent.

de.text: Hm. Du kommst wegen der Miner. Gut. Sie bezahlen alles auf diesem Schiff, also behandle sie anständig.
